**A new spin on the Org bank!**
I know for a while the Org Bank has been here and there its changed hands a few times well gone are the days!
Now introducing the [member] he is the Orgs personal Org Bank bot courteous of [member]!
Visit the #channel to get started or take a look at what's available!
🏦 **The Org Vault: A Member's Guide**
The vault is the org's shared stash: components, weapons, armor, and materials in every quality (rarity), so we can pool what we've got and craft gear together for the org. The Vault Bot keeps track of all of it. Here's everything you need to know, and it's not much.

items.body:
See everything that's in stock right now. Only you can see the list, so browse all you want without spamming the channel. It's a great way to check what's there before you /request.

Lists every command you're able to use, with a quick line on what each one does. If you forget everything else on this page, remember this one.

Daily report: every morning at 8am Pacific. It covers what came in, what went out, and the new totals. It only posts when the inventory actually changed, so a quiet day means no post. 😴

# 🥊 **Fight Night: How It Works**
Fight Night just got a serious upgrade. The bot now tracks every aUEC that moves through the night: buy-ins, bets, winnings, all of it. No more scribbled notes and "wait, who owed who?" At the end, you get one payout for everything you won.
** Want to fight?**
Click **Join** on the fight card, then pay your buy-in to the Treasurer. You have to sign up through the bot, even if you're standing right next to the Treasurer with cash in hand. If it's not in the bot, it doesn't count.
Once the Treasurer confirms your payment, your ⏳ turns into a ✅ and you're in.

items.title: **__Org News__**
items.body:
🚀 The First SDAS Comic Is Here!
With the release of SDAS's first official comic, we're excited to announce a brand-new addition to the SDAS website!
You'll now find a "Comics" tab at the top of the website, where you can explore comics and stories created by members of Some Dudes and a Spaceship!
📖 Here's how it works:
Read & Explore: Browse comics and stories created by fellow SDAS members.
Create & Share: Members with the rank of Prospect or higher can publish their own original comics and stories for everyone to enjoy.
Join the Conversation: Anyone, including non-members, can read, like, and comment on published content!
